# Digital Standout Blog

> Digital Standout helps healthcare and aesthetic practices master AI-driven SEO and patient discovery in an evolving search landscape.

This blog focuses on how AI, local SEO, and patient experience strategies are transforming how medical practices, med spas, and aesthetic clinics attract and convert patients. Content covers Google's AI Overview, review management, and emerging search behaviors.

## Key Topics

- Google's AI Overview
- Local SEO
- Med spa SEO
- Patient reviews
- AI search optimization
- Google Business Profile
- Healthcare marketing
- Patient discovery
- Search intent
- AI-generated descriptions
- Near-me searches
- Medical practice marketing
- Local pack rankings
- Patient search behavior
- Featured snippets

## AI Search & Google's Transformation

- [How Google's AI Is Changing SEO for Healthcare and Aesthetic Practices](https://blog.digitalstandout.com/how-googles-ai-is-changing-seo-for-healthcare-and-aesthetic-practices): Google AI transforms SEO strategy for medical and aesthetic practice discovery.
- [The Future of Med Spa SEO: What AI Means for Getting Found Online](https://blog.digitalstandout.com/the-future-of-med-spa-seo-what-ai-means-for-getting-found-online): AI-powered search reshapes med spa SEO rankings and patient acquisition strategy.
- [What Happens When AI Describes Your Practice Before a Patient Clicks](https://blog.digitalstandout.com/what-happens-when-ai-describes-your-practice-before-a-patient-clicks): AI-generated descriptions shape patient first impressions in Google search results.
- [AI Search Optimization for Medical Practices](https://blog.digitalstandout.com/ai-search-optimization-for-medical-practices): AI search optimization helps medical practices attract patients and boost conversions.

## Local SEO & Patient Discovery

- [How Local SEO Is Evolving for AI-Powered "Near Me" Patient Searches](https://blog.digitalstandout.com/how-local-seo-is-evolving-for-ai-powered-near-me-patient-searches): AI transforms local SEO for near-me patient searches and practice discovery.
- [How Patient Reviews Influence Your Local Google Rankings](https://blog.digitalstandout.com/how-patient-reviews-influence-your-local-google-rankings): Patient reviews impact local SEO rankings and visibility in Google local pack.
- [The New Med Spa SEO: How Patient Experience Drives Rankings](https://blog.digitalstandout.com/the-new-med-spa-seo-how-patient-experience-drives-rankings): Patient experience and reviews now drive med spa SEO rankings and growth.
